content.introduction: The 2026 U.S. Economic Calendar includes scheduled releases such as the FOMC Rate Decision on December 9, Consumer Price Index (CPI) on December 10, Producer Price Index (PPI) on December 15, and Advance Monthly Retail Sales on December 16. Other scheduled reports include Personal Income and Outlays (PCE Inflation) on November 25, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on December 1, and Employment Situation (Nonfarm Payrolls) on December 4. The calendar also lists the FOMC Meeting Minutes for November 18 and GDP (Second Estimate) for November 25. The September 2026 calendar includes released data such as the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on September 1 and 29, GDP (Third Estimate) on September 30, and Personal Income and Outlays (PCE Inflation) on September 30. The PCE Inflation report for August 2026 was released on September 30, showing personal income up +0.2%, current-dollar consumer spending up +0.5%, and a saving rate of 3.8%.
